STEP 6 of the pipeline (runs AFTER Meteo.Rmd).

Purpose
-------
Add extraterrestrial radiation (Ra), Hargreaves PET (catchment-scale `PET` and
basin-scale `bsn_PET`) and day-of-year sin / cos features to the joined daily
drivers. The math runs inside DuckDB so the full table never sits in R memory.

Inputs
------
`catchments.gpkg` (Catchments.Rmd) and `daily_drivers_dir/drivers_daily_joined.parquet`
(Meteo.Rmd).

End-state of this file
----------------------
**`drivers_daily.parquet`** — one row per (comid, date) with all GridMET drivers,
Ra, PET, bsn_PET, DOY, DOY_sin, DOY_cos. Consumed by Q_Processing_python.py.

Comment style (inside every chunk): `## N.` section, `###` step, `####` note,
`#` inline bit. Same convention as every other script in SRC/.

```{r setup, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
## 1. Setup
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

### Load shared paths, packages and helper functions
source("SRC/Functions_Paths.R")
```

```{r}
## 2. Catchment latitude lookup
### Read catchments and take each polygon centroid
#### Latitude is the only geometry PET needs (it drives Ra)
catchments <- st_read(catchment_path, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(comid = as.character(comid))

catchments_centroid <- st_centroid(catchments)

### Build a small comid / lon / lat table
catchment_lat <- catchments_centroid %>%
  st_coordinates() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename(lon = X, lat = Y) %>%
  mutate(comid = catchments$comid) %>%
  select(comid, lon, lat)

# keep this small lookup table in memory
head(catchment_lat)
```

```{r}
## 3. Compute Ra and PET in DuckDB
### Set input / output parquet paths
drivers_in_file <- file.path(daily_drivers_dir, "drivers_daily_joined.parquet")
drivers_pet_out_file <- file.path(daily_drivers_dir, "drivers_daily.parquet")

### Open an in-memory DuckDB connection
con <- dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), dbdir = ":memory:")

### Register the latitude lookup table in DuckDB
dbWriteTable(con, "catchment_lat", catchment_lat, overwrite = TRUE)

### Join latitude, compute Ra / PET / DOY features and write parquet
#### Ra = FAO-56 extraterrestrial radiation (mm/day) from latitude and day of year
#### PET = 0.0023 * (Tmean + 17.8) * sqrt(Tmax - Tmin) * Ra  (Hargreaves)
#### PET uses catchment temperatures; bsn_PET uses the basin-scale (area-weighted upstream) temperatures
#### DOY_sin / DOY_cos encode the seasonal cycle for the model
dbExecute(con, paste0("
COPY (
  SELECT
    d.*,
    cl.lon,
    cl.lat,

    -- Day of year
    CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) AS DOY,

    -- Extraterrestrial radiation, Ra, in mm/day
    (
      (
        (24 * 60 / pi()) * 0.0820 *
        (1 + 0.033 * cos(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER))) *
        (
          acos(
            -tan(cl.lat * pi() / 180) *
            tan(0.409 * sin(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) - 1.39))
          ) *
          sin(cl.lat * pi() / 180) *
          sin(0.409 * sin(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) - 1.39))
          +
          cos(cl.lat * pi() / 180) *
          cos(0.409 * sin(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) - 1.39)) *
          sin(
            acos(
              -tan(cl.lat * pi() / 180) *
              tan(0.409 * sin(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) - 1.39))
            )
          )
        )
      ) * 0.408
    ) AS Ra,

    -- Catchment-scale Hargreaves PET
    0.0023 * (d.tmean_c + 17.8) *
      sqrt(greatest(d.tmax_c - d.tmin_c, 0)) *
      (
        (
          (24 * 60 / pi()) * 0.0820 *
          (1 + 0.033 * cos(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER))) *
          (
            acos(
              -tan(cl.lat * pi() / 180) *
              tan(0.409 * sin(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) - 1.39))
            ) *
            sin(cl.lat * pi() / 180) *
            sin(0.409 * sin(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) - 1.39))
            +
            cos(cl.lat * pi() / 180) *
            cos(0.409 * sin(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) - 1.39)) *
            sin(
              acos(
                -tan(cl.lat * pi() / 180) *
                tan(0.409 * sin(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) - 1.39))
              )
            )
          )
        ) * 0.408
      ) AS PET,

    -- Basin-scale Hargreaves PET
    0.0023 * (d.bsn_tmean_c + 17.8) *
      sqrt(greatest(d.bsn_tmax_c - d.bsn_tmin_c, 0)) *
      (
        (
          (24 * 60 / pi()) * 0.0820 *
          (1 + 0.033 * cos(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER))) *
          (
            acos(
              -tan(cl.lat * pi() / 180) *
              tan(0.409 * sin(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) - 1.39))
            ) *
            sin(cl.lat * pi() / 180) *
            sin(0.409 * sin(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) - 1.39))
            +
            cos(cl.lat * pi() / 180) *
            cos(0.409 * sin(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) - 1.39)) *
            sin(
              acos(
                -tan(cl.lat * pi() / 180) *
                tan(0.409 * sin(2 * pi() / 365 * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) - 1.39))
              )
            )
          )
        ) * 0.408
      ) AS bsn_PET,

    sin(2 * pi() * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) / 365) AS DOY_sin,
    cos(2 * pi() * CAST(strftime(d.date, '%j') AS INTEGER) / 365) AS DOY_cos

  FROM read_parquet('", drivers_in_file, "') d
  LEFT JOIN catchment_lat cl
  ON CAST(d.comid AS VARCHAR) = CAST(cl.comid AS VARCHAR)
)
TO '", drivers_pet_out_file, "'
(FORMAT PARQUET);
"))

### Close the connection
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

cat("Saved PET-enhanced daily drivers to:", drivers_pet_out_file, "\n")
```

```{r}
## 4. Sanity check
### Make sure the calculations were made (share of non-missing values per column)

drivers_pet <- arrow::read_parquet(file.path(daily_drivers_dir, "drivers_daily.parquet"))

drivers_pet %>%
  summarise(
    n_rows = n(),
    n_comids = n_distinct(comid),
    pct_Ra = mean(!is.na(Ra)),
    pct_PET = mean(!is.na(PET)),
    pct_bsn_tmean_c = mean(!is.na(bsn_tmean_c)),
    pct_bsn_PET = mean(!is.na(bsn_PET)),
    pct_bsn_temp_and_Ra = mean(
      !is.na(bsn_tmax_c) &
      !is.na(bsn_tmin_c) &
      !is.na(bsn_tmean_c) &
      !is.na(Ra)
    )
  )
```
